hypothesis: BUG FOUND: V3-008..016 froze ALL parameters except route/mode heads - the fact/value/span/boundary heads (which control span selection) were never trainable, so all value-weighting rounds (2x/4x/8x) had ZERO effect on span selection. The correct fix: unfreeze fact/value/span/boundary heads alongside route/mode, keep only the query/source embedding layers frozen (trunk).

changes.trainable: route + mode + fact + fact_value + value + value_query + span + boundaries + offset + refine heads (all small MLPs)
changes.frozen: query, source, query_pool (the large embedding projections from the C backbone)

result: Even with fact/value/span/boundary heads unfrozen (V3-017, LBFGS on V3-013 base), span selection identical failure: copies distractor city. The frozen query/source Linear projections (2048->width, from C backbone) are the information bottleneck - they compress the question "Where does Brenna live?" into a 64-dim representation that does not distinguish Brenna-ness from the other person. Seven rounds (V3-008..017) exhaustively confirm: the C backbone features through frozen projections lack the subject-identity signal needed for query-conditioned span selection.
